description: Terrain, imagery and land-cover sources available to Phase 1, with Israel as the focus. Imagery, elevation and land cover are separate kinds. readiness: ready (usable now), ready-not-wired (local data validated but not connected to the runtime), needs-data (tooling exists but its output is not in the repository), needs-keys-or-deployment (an online adapter that is not a ready source), test-only. New providers and automatic region downloads are out of scope.

sources.name: Synthetic level pad
sources.source: apps/web/src/FlightScene.tsx draws a 2000 m by 2000 m level plane; the physics ground is level at the origin height
sources.coverage: Any location; level at the origin height
sources.notes: Works without map services. TASK-186 makes it explicitly selectable at run time.

sources.name: ESA WorldCover 10 m 2021 v200, Israel tiles
sources.license: CC-BY-4.0; attribution: ESA WorldCover project 2021 / Contains modified Copernicus Sentinel data (2021) processed by ESA WorldCover consortium
sources.coverage: Tiles N27E033, N30E033 and N33E033: 27 to 36 degrees north, 33 to 36 degrees east. Supported region: Israel only; tile extents reaching neighboring countries do not extend supported coverage
sources.decision: Decoded and validated but not registered as a runtime DataManifest. Land cover is not elevation or imagery; TASK-186 decides whether it is shown as a material layer.

sources.name: FABDEM V1-2 bare-earth elevation (local quantized-mesh terrain)
sources.source: scripts/geodata/fetch_fabdem.py and scripts/geodata/build_terrain.py over the bounding box in config/geodata.json; run by hand, output kept outside the repository
sources.license: CC BY-NC-SA 4.0 (non-commercial; commercial use needs a Fathom licence); contains modified Copernicus DEM GLO-30
sources.coverage: The config/geodata.json bounding box, 34.2 to 35.9 degrees east and 29.4 to 33.4 degrees north, once prepared
sources.resolution: 1 arc-second (about 30 m) source; terrain tiles to zoom 13, and zoom 15 inside the configured area
sources.decision: D-09 (TASK-131): whether the non-commercial license fits the stakeholder's use, and whether a locally prepared FABDEM terrain set is the Phase 1 elevation source.

sources.name: EGM2008 geoid grid (us_nga_egm08_25.tif)
sources.source: PROJ data CDN, fetched by the manual geodata setup; not in the repository
sources.decision: D-09 (TASK-131) records the license; TASK-148 stores the grid with source and SHA-256 in data/geoid/inventory.json.

sources.name: Overture Maps buildings as 3D Tiles
sources.source: scripts/geodata/build_buildings.py over the config/geodata.json bounding box; run by hand, output kept outside the repository
sources.license: ODbL-1.0 or CDLA-Permissive-2.0 per Overture release; attribution: Overture Maps Foundation, OpenStreetMap contributors
sources.coverage: The config/geodata.json bounding box once prepared
sources.resolution: Building footprints with heights from Overture, floor counts or a 6 m default
sources.decision: D-09 (TASK-131): whether Phase 1 shows buildings; ODbL share-alike applies to any distributed derived database.

sources.name: OpenStreetMap features for the material map
sources.source: scripts/geodata/extract_osm.py over a local OSM PBF extract supplied by the operator
sources.decision: D-09 (TASK-131): whether Phase 1 uses OSM features at all.

sources.name: Google Photorealistic 3D Tiles through the tiles worker proxy
sources.source: services/tiles-worker (TASK-063) in front of the Google Map Tiles API
sources.license: Google Maps Platform terms; attribution required; no offline caching or prefetch without permission
sources.decision: D-09 (TASK-131): S17 allows external map services to require connectivity; this source is never offline and is not a ready source without keys and a deployment.

sources.name: Synthetic 3D Tiles test sets
sources.source: tests/fixtures/tiles and tests/fixtures/tiles-implicit, generated in the repository

gaps: No offline imagery exists for any region; the only imagery source is the online Google proxy, which needs keys and a deployment.
No elevation data is in the repository; the FABDEM tooling exists, but its output is prepared by hand, kept outside the repository and licensed for non-commercial use only.
WorldCover land cover for Israel is validated but not wired into the runtime.
No geoid grid is in the repository, so elevation above sea level cannot yet be converted to ellipsoidal height offline (TASK-148).
Outside the Israel WorldCover tiles and any locally prepared FABDEM area, only the synthetic pad is available.
